Each has an x-axis with ticks from 50 to 400 and a y-axis labelled Accuracy; there are no legends or printed point values. The charts are grouped by colored headings: blue Math Reasoning, orange Code Reasoning, and green Overall Performance. In Math Reasoning, AIME 2024 and AIME 2025 fluctuate sharply, with low dips and intermittent peaks; Olympiad Bench varies more gently around 0.38–0.43. Minerva rises to about 0.41 early, falls to a pronounced low near x=350, then rebounds sharply by x=400. Math 500 stays comparatively steady and high, mostly around 0.75–0.79. AMC 2023 fluctuates substantially, with peaks around x=270–290 and a deep late dip. In Code Reasoning, HumanEval+ remains broadly steady near 0.80, with a mid-range high around 0.83; MBPP+ fluctuates narrowly around 0.71–0.73, including a dip near x=250; LiveCodeBench trends upward overall from about 0.33 to around 0.38, with modest fluctuations. Overall Performance contains Math Average, which fluctuates and has a late dip before recovering; Code Average, which generally rises from about 0.615 to the mid-0.63s; and Overall Average, which varies around 0.50–0.53. A red star marks the Overall Average line near x=300 and accuracy 0.533.
